args.sql:
WITH SafeLightLevels AS (
    SELECT
        'High' AS sensitivity,
        50 AS max_lux
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'Medium' AS sensitivity,
        200 AS max_lux
),
ArtifactLightStatus AS (
    SELECT
        a.artregistry,
        a.artname,
        a.mattype,
        s.lightsensitivity,
        CASE
            WHEN l.lightlux > sll.max_lux THEN 'Over Exposure'
            ELSE 'Within Limits'
        END AS status
    FROM
        artifactscore a
    JOIN
        sensitivitydata s ON a.artregistry = s.artref
    JOIN
        lightandradiationreadings l ON s.artref = l.lightradregistry
    JOIN
        SafeLightLevels sll ON s.lightsensitivity = sll.sensitivity
)
SELECT
    artregistry AS "Registry Number",
    artname AS Name,
    mattype AS "Material Type",
    lightsensitivity AS "Light Sensitivity",
    status AS "Current Status"
FROM
    ArtifactLightStatus;
